corrections.text: The article quotes TechCrunch as writing that "all physical experiments are conducted by human scientists." TechCrunch's actual sentence is: "The physical experiments were done by humans." The underlying fact — that humans, not Claude, perform the physical lab work — is accurate and independently confirmed by Anthropic, but the quoted wording was not TechCrunch's own.

The article quotes TechCrunch as writing that "the AI processed approximately 210 million tokens using roughly 950 agents to search through biological data." TechCrunch's actual sentence is: "Claude searched through data using about 950 agents that burned through 210 million tokens." The figures (950 agents, 210 million tokens) are correct and match Anthropic's own announcement, but the quoted phrasing was not TechCrunch's own.
